editionLabel: Days of Wonder English rulebook, 2025 refresh
firstPlayerRule: The scenario's briefing notes name which side plays first; that side's player begins by playing a command card (in Pegasus Bridge, the Allies). Players then alternate turns.
clarifications: Choosing sides is separate from turn order: the rulebook recommends playing each scenario twice, swapping sides.
In the 3-4 player Operation Alliance team mode, sides still alternate starting with the side named by the scenario; the 1st player of the starting team goes first.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rules linked from the Days of Wonder Memoir '44 page (https://www.daysofwonder.com/game/memoir44/), SHA-256 12af03e45c15e160c546bbd2e783e3003d9beea349dd691310f080cab51be160, and extracted the text of all 14 PDF pages. The PDF uses two-page spreads, so only PDF positions are cited. PDF page 3, Setup step 13: the starting player, as indicated in the scenario's briefing notes (in Pegasus Bridge, the Allies), begins play by playing one command card; step 9 recommends playing from both sides. PDF page 4, Game Turn: each scenario indicates which side plays first; players then alternate turns. PDF page 12, Operation Alliance team mode: sides alternate turns starting with the side indicated in the scenario setup; the 1st player of the starting team goes first. PDF page 13 shows copyright 2025 Days of Wonder. The WWII command-card hex battle game matches BGG 10630. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The starting side varies by scenario; the rulebook does not say how to decide which person plays which side beyond recommending playing both sides.
